subject: maths
question: A sector of a circle having a radius 10 cm has area 50 cm sq. Find the angle of the sector.
solution:
**Given:**

Radius of the circle = 10 cm

Area of the sector = 50 cm²

**Formula Used:**

Area of sector = (θ/360) × π × r²

**Calculation:**

⇒ 50 = (θ/360) × π × 10²

⇒ 50 = (θ/360) × π × 100

⇒ θ = (50 × 360) ÷ (π × 100)

⇒ θ = 18000 ÷ (100 × π)

⇒ θ = 180 ÷ π

⇒ θ ≈ 57.3 degrees

**∴ The correct answer is 57.3 degrees.**
